notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers!

The Update 1.01 is come.
Now we support Linux and Mac OS.
And my wonderful friend helped translate the game into an additional language: Russian.

Now you can buy Space Roguelike Adventure as part of a great bundle RUN AND JUMP BUNDLE with two other colorful platformer games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30364/RUN_AND_JUMP_BUNDLE/

In the game we also have an alternate ending where you refuse to continue killing monsters. You need to stand near the main white regent in the hub at any time after completing the tutorial level and hold the use button a 3-5 seconds. After that you will see the ending cutscene and recieve all achivements, but...no spoilers more.

We hope these improvement will allow you to save the universe better, faster, higher and enjoy the game more. And don't forget to write us your reviews.
Have a nice game ːsteamthumbsupː
